title: RD lookup does not serve application/link-format
description: RFC 9176 s4.2 MUST support application/link-format. LICHEN RD lookup currently only returns Content-Format 60 CBOR. Parsed requirements on l1qw.7.14.2.1 call this out; CBOR is allowed as an additional format (MAY) but link-format is still required. Honor Accept, default link-format or document a LICHEN-only CBOR profile in the spec.
close_reason: GET /rd-lookup/res honors Accept: 40 returns RFC 6690 link-format, 60 or omitted returns CBOR 60 (LICHEN default). Unknown Accept is 4.06. Tests: test_lookup_link_format_when_accepted, test_lookup_rejects_unknown_accept. pytest RD 73 passed, 2 xfail.
